# Magic Storage 1.1.0

**Now available for Minecraft 1.20.1 (Forge) as well as 1.21.11!**

### New
- **Resonance Console** — right-click the Heart with the Tuning Fork of Reigal to open a live map of your cell network; inspect any cell's contents and drag-move stacks between cells. Defrag is now a button inside the console.
- **Inactive-cell indicator** — cells that aren't connected (or are beyond the Heart's capacity) now render grey, so you can tell at a glance what's live.
- Cheaper Tuning Fork recipe — 4 gold + 2 amethyst.

### Minecraft 1.20.1
- Full backport to Minecraft 1.20.1 / Forge 47.x — download `magic_storage-1.20.1-1.1.0.jar`.
- Includes a fix for the search-suggestion dropdown z-order.

### Downloads
- `magic_storage-1.21.11-1.1.0.jar` — Minecraft 1.21.11, Forge 61+
- `magic_storage-1.20.1-1.1.0.jar` — Minecraft 1.20.1, Forge 47+

releases.notes: Major update introducing Tier 2 Heart Storage (multi-block 1x2, 16 cells) with Gemini-generated textures, plus a global Quick Dump hotkey from the world (5-block radius). Two critical bugs fixed: cell content disappearing after network growth (now stateful Heart preserves connections across BFS reruns), and client disconnect on menu open (now sync connected positions through openMenu buf). T1 capacity reduced from 128 to 4 cells — meaningful upgrade pressure to T2. See CHANGELOG.md for the full list.

releases.notes:
## Added
- Brand-new dark glass GUI (256x236), drawn entirely via `gfx.fill` (no PNG texture). Subtle frosted-glass alpha lets the world slightly bleed through behind the panel.
- Vertical filter panel with 6 vanilla item-sprite buttons: Show all, Potions, Armor, Tools & weapons, Food, Blocks. Active filter highlighted with a purple border + inner glow.
- Storage grid widened to 12x6 (was 9x6), 72 visible slots — +33% more items on screen.
- Quick Dump button + rebindable hotkey (default `X`) — dumps the player''s main inventory (excluding hotbar) into storage with merge-then-place semantics.
- 3-tone fill bar (green/yellow/red) between the Inventory label and the used/total counter, sharing the same thresholds as the Heart `fill_level`.

## Fixed
- 🔴 **Item loss on shift-click into empty cells.** Forge `ItemStackHandler.insertItem` aliases the caller stack into an empty slot, and the old `setCount(0)` for loop control zeroed the already-stored items. Now passing a copy and shrinking the original by diff (`insertCopyAndShrink`).
- **Crash safety** when a connected Cell is broken with the GUI open. The menu now closes on the next tick (snapshot of cell positions in `stillValid` + `isRemoved` check in handler).

## Changed
- Storage interaction uses an internal `distributeIntoStorage(stack)` (merge → place) instead of vanilla `moveItemStackTo`, much faster at 128-cell scale.
- Player inventory and hotbar are now centred horizontally inside the wider GUI.

## Internal
- Built against **Minecraft 1.21.11**, **Forge 61.1.0**, **Java 21**.
- Jar name format `magic_storage-<mcver>-<modver>.jar` via `base.archivesName` in `build.gradle`.

releases.notes:
First public beta of Magic Storage — a magic-themed storage system for Minecraft Forge 1.21.11.

## What's in
- **Heart Storage** with 4 visual states based on fill level (dormant → green → yellow → red)
- **Storage Cell** — 27-slot connected storage, BFS face-neighbor network up to 128 cells per heart
- GUI with search, sort by name/count/mod, scroll
- Items physically stored in cells (break the heart, cells stay intact; break a cell, its items drop)
- Own creative tab with both blocks
- Crafting recipes (cell: copper + chest + redstone, heart: redstone + gems + obsidian)

## Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Forge 61.1.0 or newer
- Java 21

## Install
Drop the jar into your `.minecraft/mods/` folder.

## Status
Early access. Working as a prototype. Missing polish:
- shift-click distribute across the network
- sound effects
- JEI/REI integration
- config for cell limit
- custom GUI background (currently using vanilla generic_54)
- `storage_cell` texture not yet tileable across cube faces

Feedback welcome via Issues.
